description: Source code for loading and processing derivatives YAML files into autograd function representations, including functions for creating derivatives, handling forward derivatives, and managing derivative info for PyTorch autograd.

methods.name: add_view_copy_derivatives
methods.description: Adds derivatives for view copy variants based on view groups.

methods.name: load_derivatives
methods.description: Loads derivatives YAML files, parses, caches, and returns differentiability info and used dispatch keys.

methods.name: cpp_arguments
methods.description: Retrieves C++ arguments for a native function, considering symint signatures.

methods.name: create_derivative
methods.description: Constructs a Derivative object from a formula, variable names, and available gradients.

methods.name: create_forward_derivative
methods.description: Creates a ForwardDerivative object based on a formula and variable names.

methods.name: postprocess_forward_derivatives
methods.description: Adjusts forward derivatives based on specific formulas like auto_element_wise and auto_linear.

methods.name: used_gradient_indices
methods.description: Extracts indices used in grads[] expressions within formulas.

methods.name: saved_variables
methods.description: Analyzes a formula to identify variables to save for autograd, replacing expressions with saved attributes.
